name: RTMP Broadcast
description: Broadcast the video you are watching in Jellyfin Web to an RTMP or RTMPS destination. The stream follows your playback and subtitles, with optional on-screen Twitch chat.
overview: Send your Jellyfin Web playback to an RTMP or RTMPS server.

versions.changelog: Initial release. Broadcast from Jellyfin Web or the Android web player with playback sync, subtitles, hardware acceleration and optional Twitch chat.
